rt:param.name: Obj_Type_Nr
rt:param.comment: Номер схемы сигналов из конф. файла от 1 до 6

rt:var.name: STrig
rt:var.comment: наш вывод в ремонт - запрет управления

rt:var.name: More_signals
rt:var.comment: Есть ещё сигналы, найденные по маске

rt:var.name: Mask
rt:var.comment: Маска поиска дополнительных сигналов, сконструированная по гибкому правилу с учётом наличия точек

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub HighlightMessage(ByVal TxtObj As RtSvgObj, ByVal pv As PlsPVBin, ByVal mask As UShort, ByVal HighlightColor As Int) If (pv == Nothing) || (mask == 0) Then TxtObj.visibility = "hidden" Else TxtObj.visibility = "visible" If pv.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then TxtObj.fill = 0xa0a0a0 TxtObj.font_size = 11 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" TxtObj.text_decoration = "password" ElseIf (pv.Value & mask) != 0 Then TxtObj.text_decoration = "none" TxtObj.fill = HighlightColor TxtObj.font_size = 13 TxtObj.font_weight = "bold" Else TxtObj.text_decoration = "none" TxtObj.fill = 0xa0a0a0 TxtObj.font_size = 11 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" End If End If End Sub

Sub HighlightMessageSimple(ByVal TxtObj As RtSvgObj, ByVal Highlight As Boolean, ByVal HighlightColor As Int) If Highlight Then TxtObj.fill = HighlightColor TxtObj.font_size = 13 TxtObj.font_weight = "bold" Else TxtObj.fill = 0xa0a0a0 TxtObj.font_size = 11 TxtObj.font_weight = "normal" End If End Sub

Sub Open_diag() HighlightMessage(OPEN, pv_OPEN, mask_OPEN, 0) If Is_NARY Then HighlightMessage(CLOSED, pv_OPEN, mask_CLOSED, 0) HighlightMessage(NOT_OPEN, pv_OPEN, mask_NOT_OPEN, 0) HighlightMessage(NOT_CLOSED, pv_OPEN, mask_NOT_CLOSED, 0) HighlightMessage(INTERMEDIATE, pv_OPEN, mask_INTERMEDIATE, 0) HighlightMessage(OPENING, pv_OPEN, mask_OPENING, 0) HighlightMessage(CLOSING, pv_OPEN, mask_CLOSING, 0) HighlightMessage(OPEN_MISMATCH, pv_OPEN, mask_OPEN_MISMATCH, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(CLOSE_MISMATCH, pv_OPEN, mask_CLOSE_MISMATCH, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(OPEN_OVERTIME, pv_OPEN, mask_OPEN_OVERTIME, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(CLOSE_OVERTIME, pv_OPEN, mask_CLOSE_OVERTIME, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(OPEN_HI_MOMENT, pv_OPEN, mask_OPEN_HI_MOMENT, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(CLOSE_HI_MOMENT, pv_OPEN, mask_CLOSE_HI_MOMENT, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(FAIL, pv_OPEN, mask_FAIL, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(FAIL_BLINK, pv_OPEN, mask_FAIL_BLINK, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(INVALID, pv_OPEN, mask_INVALID, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(UNDEFINED, pv_OPEN, mask_UNDEFINED, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(TEST, pv_OPEN, mask_TEST, Middle_Color_Wieghted(Color_Imitation, 0,0.75)) HighlightMessage(REPAIR, pv_OPEN, mask_REPAIR, 0xf5) HighlightMessage(SELECTED, pv_OPEN, mask_SELECTED, 0) End If End Sub
